fomod.Name: NordenUI
fomod.Author: Nithog
fomod.Description:
Norden UI is an interface overhaul that seamlessly merges three core principles: the clean functionality of modern design, the rustic feel of the Nords, and the sophisticated restraint of a muted, monochromatic color scheme. The result is a deeply immersive experience that feels both timeless and current, pulling you deeper into the world of Tamriel without ever breaking your focus.
It's based on my previous UI - Oathvein synthesizing the best elements of Dear Diary Dark Mode, Edge UI, Nordic UI, New Horizon UI, and Horizon UI Remake into a cohesive new vision.
